question: In Table 1, which technologies have the highest and the lowest upper bound of estimated energy density improvement, and how far apart are those bounds?
expect: highest: Section 9 ultra-high-speed (thick) electrode processing, 325-350 Wh/kg; lowest: Section 8 coating parameter and drying protocols, 220-240; 350 - 240 = 110 Wh/kg
rendered:
According to Table 1, the highest upper bound of estimated energy density improvement is 325-350 Wh/kg (Section 5 – Water-Based Processing of Si/C Anodes (N:P = 1.1) and Section 7 – Co-Free NFA), and the lowest upper bound is 225-250 Wh/kg (Section 6 – Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes (i.e. NMC 811)).

The difference between the highest and the lowest upper bound is 75-100 Wh/kg.
